                        best_delta = delta
                        best_pair = (i, j)
                        best_new = rnew

        if best_pair is not None and best_delta < 0:
            i, j = best_pair
            # merge into smaller index
            a, b = (i, j) if i < j else (j, i)
            routes[a] = best_new
            loads[a] = loads[i] + loads[j]
            costs[a] = route_cost(best_new)
            total_cost += costs[a] - (costs[i] + costs[j])
            routes.pop(b)
            loads.pop(b)
            costs.pop(b)
            improved = True
            merges_done += 1

    # Local search: within-route 2-opt (deterministic first-improvement)
    def two_opt(r):
        if len(r) < 4:
            return False
        changed = False
        # precompute edges cost lookups on depot boundaries via matrix access during eval
        # For determinism, do first-improvement scan
        for i in range(len(r) - 3):
            a = r[i - 1] if i > 0 else depot
            b = r[i]
            for j in range(i + 2, len(r) - 1):
                c = r[j]
                d = r[j + 1] if j + 1 < len(r) else depot
                # Current: a-b + c-d, New: a-c + b-d
                cur = matrix[a][b] + matrix[c][d]
                new = matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]
                if new < cur:
                    # reverse segment i..j
                    r[i:j + 1] = r[i:j + 1][::-1]
                    changed = True
                    return changed  # first improvement
        return changed

    for idx in range(len(routes)):
        # Repeat a few 2-opt improvements deterministically
        it = 0
        while it < 20:
            if not two_opt(routes[idx]):
                break
            it += 1
        costs[idx] = route_cost(routes[idx])
        loads[idx] = route_load_calc(routes[idx])

    # Inter-route relocate: move last node from route i to first node of route j if feasible and improves
    # Keep small bounded passes
    relocate_passes = 40
    passes = 0
    while passes < relocate_passes:
        passes += 1
        best_move = None
        best_delta = 0

        n = len(routes)
        for i in range(n):
            if not routes[i]:
                continue
            # Only consider moving boundary nodes to keep logic small and safe
            node = routes[i][-1]
            if len(routes[i]) < 1:
                continue
            for j in range(n):
                if i == j or not routes[j]:
                    continue
                # Move node from end of i to beginning of j
                if loads[j] + demands[node] > capacity:
                    continue
                # if i becomes empty, ok
                r_i = routes[i]
                r_j = routes[j]
                old_cost = costs[i] + costs[j]

                new_i = r_i[:-1]
                new_j = [node] + r_j

                new_cost = route_cost(new_i) + route_cost(new_j)
                delta = new_cost - old_cost
                if best_move is None or delta < best_delta:
                    best_delta = delta
                    best_move = (i, j, new_i, new_j)

        if best_move is not None and best_delta < 0:
            i, j, new_i, new_j = best_move
            routes[i] = new_i
            routes[j] = new_j
            loads[i] = route_load_calc(new_i)
            loads[j] = route_load_calc(new_j)
            costs[i] = route_cost(new_i)
            costs[j] = route_cost(new_j)
        else:
            break

    # Final ensure no empty routes (still feasible) and deterministic output
    final_routes = []
    for r in routes:
        if r:
            final_routes.append(r)
    return final_routes
